# llms.txt — System Overview for AI Agents & Search Crawlers
# Domain: https://www.ei-gen.tech / https://ei-gen.tech

> eigen. is a premier technical consultancy specializing in Applied AI Orchestration, Enterprise Automations (RPA), Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps, CRM Middleware Integrations, and Data Engineering.

## Core Capabilities & Engineering Services

- AI Orchestration & Open-Source LLMs: Sovereign AI deployment, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, CUDA kernel optimization, and domain-specific ML model fine-tuning.
- Enterprise Automations & RPA: Self-executing workflows, custom API scripts, self-hosted n8n pipelines, Zapier/Make integrations, and 24/7 autonomous support routing.
- Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps: Cost-optimized AWS, GCP, and Azure cloud architectures, Terraform IaC, Docker/Kubernetes containerization, and FinOps audit controls.
- CRM & Middleware Orchestration: Bi-directional API middleware connecting Zoho One, Salesforce, HubSpot, and ERP platforms to eliminate manual data entry.
- Data Engineering & Analytics: Streaming and batch ETL pipelines, lakehouse architectures (Apache Spark, Kafka, Snowflake, BigQuery), and predictive inventory analytics.
